**Newsletter: Recycled Paper Acceptance at Our Print Shop**

Dear Artists,

Starting May 8, our print shop accepts recycled paper for all your projects. This change not only supports our commitment to sustainability but also enhances the quality and environmental friendliness of your prints.

We encourage you to bring a sample of recycled paper to our shop. This will help us ensure that we are using the right materials and can provide you with the best service.

Thank you for choosing our print shop. We are excited to continue serving you with the highest quality prints.

Best regards,
[Your Name]  
Founder, Your Print Shop
